questions.q: In the comic series, Rasputin aligns himself with which wartime regime?
questions.why: The comic Rasputin works with the Nazis, who recruit him for an occult war effort.

questions.q: Which publisher releases the comic series in which Rasputin appears?
questions.why: Dark Horse Comics publishes Hellboy and its spin-offs.

questions.q: In the comics, Rasputin's wartime ritual summons which demonic child?
questions.why: The summoning meant for Nazi use ended up delivering the baby into Allied hands.

questions.q: What is the Third Reich occult project that Rasputin directs called?
questions.why: After being revived, Rasputin steered the Nazis' work into Project Ragna Rok, bending it to his apocalyptic goal.

questions.q: In which 1994 miniseries does Rasputin make his debut?
questions.why: He debuts in Seed of Destruction, the first Hellboy miniseries by Mike Mignola and John Byrne.

questions.q: Which BPRD agent's flames finally destroy Rasputin in that 1994 miniseries?
questions.why: Abe Sapien impales him first, then Liz Sherman's fire destroys what is left of the mystic.

questions.q: Which actor played Rasputin in Guillermo del Toro's 2004 film?
questions.why: Karel Roden plays the main antagonist in the 2004 film.

questions.q: Which folk witch hid a piece of Rasputin's soul in the roots of Yggdrasil in 1895?
questions.why: By hiding the fragment, she made him immortal, long before the Ogdru Jahad revived him.

questions.q: In the 2004 film, which Third Reich assassin helps Ilsa resurrect Rasputin?
questions.why: Kroenen, a Nazi assassin, joins Ilsa in resurrecting Rasputin in the film.

questions.q: On what date in 1944 was the ritual Rasputin oversaw that summoned the demon child?
questions.why: A ritual overseen by Rasputin summoned Hellboy on December 23, 1944.
